evidence.body: [e004:f01] 2番手は0.484秒差のマックス・フェルスタッペン（レッドブル）、3番手は0.543秒差のルイス・ハミルトン（フェラーリ）だった。 [e004:f02] ルクレールは後続に大差をつける印象的な速さを見せたが、残り7分でマシンに異常が発生。 [e004:f03] アップグレードの評価に取り組むマクラーレン勢がトップ10圏外に沈むなか、中団の2チームがそろって2台をトップ10圏内に送り込んだ。 [e004:f04] ハースから今シーズン2回目のFP1に臨んだ平川亮は、17番手タイムを記録した。 [e004:f05] 刷新のアストンマーティン・ホンダAMR26が初走行 Courtesy Of Aston Martin Lagonda Limited 大規模アップグレードが施されたアストンマーティン・ホンダAMR26に乗るフェルナンド・アロンソ、2026年7月24日(金) F1ハンガリーGP FP1（ハンガロリンク） パドックの視線は、ほぼ全面的に刷新されたアストンマーティン・ホンダAMR26に集まった。 [e004:f06] 確認すべき項目が多いため、2台のAMR26はセッション序盤からハードタイヤで周回を重ね、速さよりも安定したデータ収集を優先した。 [e004:f07] フェルナンド・アロンソは1分21秒550を記録し、トップから2.475秒差の13番手につけた。 [e004:f08] 一方、ランス・ストロールは残り22分、ターン2とターン3の間を走行中にマシンの異常に見舞われてスピンした。 [e004:f09] F1チーム代表兼マネージング・テクニカル・パートナーを務めるエイドリアン・ニューウェイは、ストロールのマシンでサスペンションのトラブルが発生したと認め、原因はまだ分かっていないと説明した。 [e004:f10] また、問題が発生した部位は今回のアップグレードとは無関係だったとも明らかにした。 [e004:f11] 徹夜で組み上げたBスペック、その狙いと全貌 マクラーレン、「マクレナ」実証試験を敢行 アストンマーティンほどの規模ではないものの、マクラーレンもフロアやリヤウイングを含む大規模なアップグレードを投入した。 [e004:f12] さらに、オスカー・ピアストリに代わってFP1を担当したレオナルド・フォルナローリのマシンには、マクラーレン版の実験的なマカレナウイング、通称「マクレナ」の改良型が装着され、初の走行テストが行われた。 [e004:f13] 平川は1分22秒001の17番手を記録。 [e004:f14] サインツに怒りの声、ターン1ではロックアップ多発 セッション中盤には、フェルスタッペンがカルロス・サインツ（ウィリアムズ）に進路を塞がれ、無線で苛立ちをあらわにする場面があった。 [e004:f15] FP2は日本時間7月24日(金)24時から1時間の日程で開催される。 [e004:f16] 2026年F1第11戦 ハンガリーGP evidence.title: ‘Lot of it is breaking up’: Ominous sign for iconic track after ‘super bumpy’ F1 practice session
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The Frenchman warned of tyre problems, lack of data acquisition and too many interruptions during a scrappy session. [e005:f02] He predicted all Ferrari’s rivals would go faster over the weekend. **_Fox Sports, available on Kayo Sports, is the only place to watch every practice, qualifying session and race in the 2026 FIA Formula One World Championship™ LIVE in 4K. [e005:f03] [Join now and get your first month for just $1.](https:// ! [e005:f04] [Image 2](https:// It was also clear that Vasseur was satisfied with a strong team performance led by an untouchable lap from Hamilton who is seeking to become the first driver in F1 history to take 10 poles at the same circuit. [e005:f05] “So far, so good,” admitted Vasseur. [e005:f06] Everyone will improve.” He added that it had been difficult for Ferrari to gain understanding of their tyres’ performance because red flags, especially in the second free practice, prevented them doing a “proper long run stint”. [e005:f07] Seven-time champion Hamilton set the pace with a best lap in one minute and 18.729 seconds to beat Leclerc by 0.148 seconds, leaving world champion Lando Norris, last year’s winner, third for McLaren, but adrift by half a second. [e005:f08] Four-time champion Max Verstappen of Red Bull was fourth and George Russell fifth for Mercedes, but championship leader Kimi Antonelli, who missed FP1 when Mercedes gave his car to test driver Fred Vesti, struggled to 13th. [e005:f09] [Image 3](https:// Piastri responds to rumours | 01:14 “It was a difficult day,” he said. [e005:f10] So, there’s still some work to do for tomorrow.” Russell said he was adapting to changes in the surface. [e005:f11] “It was quite a strange day out there for everybody. [e005:f12] Budapest is an amazing track to drive, but with half of the track resurfaced it was super bumpy,” the Briton said. [e005:f13] “And a lot of it is breaking up around the last couple of corners, which is making it quite strange to drive on. [e005:f14] We feared Ferrari potentially and it seemed to be the case - they looked very, very strong.” Hamilton, who is 45 points behind Antonelli in the title race, said after last Sunday’s Belgian Grand Prix that he wanted to intensify Ferrari’s efforts and was still aiming to bid this year for his eighth world title. [e005:f15] Hamilton has a career record 104 poles and will hope on Saturday to repeat his last qualifying success, which came in Hungary in 2023, as he seeks a second win for Ferrari this year ahead of F1’s summer break. [e005:f16] Victory would be Hamilton’s ninth in Hungary, equalling his own Silverstone record for most by one driver at one track.

evidence.title: 「ミス・ジャパン東京大会準グランプリ」モデル、結婚＆妊娠ダブル発表 新郎と２ショットも公開
evidence.body: [e010:f01] 「【ご報告】」と題し、「私事ではありますがこの度、長年お付き合いしていた彼と結婚致しました」とし、「そして新しい命を授かり、現在安定期を迎えて母子共に元気に過ごしています 予定日は秋頃を予定しています」と伝えた。 [e010:f02] お相手とみられる体格の良い男性に寄り添い、大きな赤いバラの花束を抱えたツーショット写真や、左手薬指の結婚指輪ショットも披露し「これからは夫婦として、そして親になる準備をしながら幸せな家庭を築いていきたいと思います。 [e010:f03] 今後とも宜しくお願いします」と思いをつづった。 [e010:f04] ファンやフォロワーからも祝福の声に加え、「美しい可愛い天使」「夫婦仲良く、支えあい、励ましあい、助けあいながらお過ごしくださいね」「幸せになってね」などのコメントが寄せられている。 [e010:f05] 19年には「サマンサタバサガールズアワード モデルオーディション」でグランプリを受賞するなど、モデルや女優として活躍。

evidence.title: Aston Martin secures $735 million financing led by BlackRock-owned HPS Investment Partners
FIA makes Max Verstappen decision after Hungarian GP investigation
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Verstappen was summoned to the stewards on Friday following an incident with Sainz in the early stages of FP1. [e002:f02] Add us as a preferred source on Google for news you can trust Verstappen encountered a slow-moving Sainz on the approach to Turn 12, forcing the Red Bull driver to abandon a lap. [e002:f03] He then appeared to retaliate by deliberately slowing on the exit of the corner to the Turn 13 hairpin, obstructing Sainz and the Audi of Gabriel Bortoleto. [e002:f04] Verstappen found himself under investigation for erratic driving, requiring the four-time world champion to visit the stewards after FP1. [e002:f05] Max Verstappen vs Isack Hadjar: Red Bull head-to-head stats for F1 2026 season F1 2026: Head-to-head qualifying records between teammates F1 2026: Head-to-head race statistics between teammates With Sainz insisting that he was ‘not in any way affected’ by Verstappen slowing down on the exit of Turn 12, however, the stewards opted against taking further action. [e002:f06] The stewards’ report read: “The Stewards heard from the drivers of Car 3 (Max Verstappen) and Car 55 (Carlos Sainz) and the team representatives and reviewed video, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. [e002:f07] “On the approach to turn 12, Car 3 had to move off the racing line to avoid Car 55 which had slowed unexpectedly on the racing line. [e002:f08] “The Driver of Car 3 then slowed significantly at turn 12 and gesticulated to the driver of Car 55 to mark his frustration that he had been impeded by Car 55. [e002:f09] “The driver of Car 55 said that he was not in any way affected by Car 3 slowing at turn 12. [e002:f10] Verstappen remains without a victory in the F1 2026 season entering the Hungarian Grand Prix weekend. [e002:f11] Verstappen also finished third in Canada and Belgium. evidence.title: Max Verstappen and Carlos Sainz learn fate after FIA investigation
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Max Verstappen and Carlos Sainz found themselves in a scuffle during the first Free Practice session at the Hungarian GP, leading to a visit to the stewards. [e004:f02] After the meeting, the conclusion was that Verstappen would receive no further action for the incident. [e004:f03] Meanwhile, Sainz received a warning. [e004:f04] The meeting was called as a result of an incident during the first part of FP1. [e004:f05] Sainz and Verstappen were noted for "driving erratically" in Turn 12. [e004:f06] The incident was then investigated after the session. [e004:f07] The four-time World Champion was on his first push lap of the session, and when he approached Sainz, the Williams driver appeared to impede him at the entry of Turn 12. [e004:f08] The Red Bull driver was forced to take avoiding action and move in order to avoid a collision. [e004:f09] However, during the hearing, the Spaniard explained that he was experiencing an issue with his radio and could not hear his race engineer warning him that Verstappen was approaching from behind. [e004:f10] A warning for Sainz The official FIA document on the incident explained that: "On the straight approaching turn 12, Car 55 was on the racing line and braked early as Car 3 approached from behind on a push lap. [e004:f11] "Team radio recorded the engineer having warned the driver of Car 55 of Car 3’s approach more than once, but the driver of Car 55 explained that the cable to his radio was disconnected and hence he did not hear those messages. [e004:f12] "He said that he was preparing for a push lap and braked earlier for turn 12 to warm his brakes. [e004:f13] The driver of Car 3 said he was surprised to find Car 55 travelling so slowly on the line, but he did not consider the incident to be dangerous. [e004:f14] "The Stewards acknowledged that the driver of Car 55 was experiencing radio problems which explained why he did not hear the warning of Car 3’s approach. [e004:f15] However, in circumstances where the driver was without the benefit of warnings from the team, he ought not to have been preparing his brakes on the racing line and, by doing so, he hindered Car 3. [e004:f16] "As the incident occurred during Free Practice and did not in fact endanger the driver of Car 3, the Stewards determined to impose a warning." The decision document was posted by the FIA at 16:06 CET.

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e005:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e005:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e005:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e005:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e005:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e005:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e005:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e005:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e005:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e005:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: AI coding company Cursor, soon to be acquired by SpaceX, expands its CFO council
evidence.body: [e001:f01] CFOs are moving from the sidelines of AI strategy to the center of the conversation, and Cursor’s new CFO Council aims to turn that shift into a playbook for AI ROI. [e001:f02] Recommended Video Cursor, the AI coding company being acquired by SpaceX in a $60 billion all-stock transaction, has launched a CFO Council that will meet quarterly in rotating cities, beginning Aug. [e001:f03] Newly announced members on Wednesday include Michael Brophy, CFO of Natera; Bea Ordonez, CFO of Payoneer; Dinesh Jain, CFO of Firstsource; Matthew Wajner, CFO of First American; Ed Grabscheid, CFO of JFrog; and Andrew Casey, CFO of Amplitude. [e001:f04] They join members announced on July 6: Sonalee Parekh, CFO of SentinelOne; Madhur Deora, CFO of Paytm; and Aziz Megji, CFO of Asana. [e001:f05] I sat down with Cursor COO Jordan Topoleski, who helped develop the council, to discuss why the initiative came together. [e001:f06] Topoleski announced the initiative with a simple LinkedIn post and was surprised by the response, receiving numerous requests to participate. [e001:f07] Rather than using a formal application process, Cursor assembled the council through a mix of inbound interest and outreach to customers. [e001:f08] The objective, Topoleski said, is to help CFOs avoid runaway AI spending while identifying areas—from coding to finance analytics—where investments produce meaningful returns. [e001:f09] At Cursor, the company’s agent framework routes work to the most appropriate models for specific tasks, he explained. [e001:f10] Sheryl Estrada @ Leaderboard Wes Gilbreath was appointed CFO of Daybright Financial , effective July 20. [e001:f11] Matt Riordan, who has served as Daybright's CFO for the past 18 years, will continue with the company as operating CFO, where he will focus on ensuring continuity across the finance organization and supporting Gilbreath's transition. [e001:f12] Gilbreath joins Daybright from Integrity Wealth and brings nearly 20 years of experience. [e001:f13] Andrew "Andy" Aberdale was appointed president and CFO of AiM Medical Robotics , a developer of advanced robotic systems for MRI-guided neurosurgery. [e001:f14] Big Deal Nearly a quarter of U.S. workers are now “job locked,” staying in roles they’d rather leave to preserve employer-sponsored health coverage—a trend with direct implications for labor mobility, talent strategy, and long-term productivity. [e001:f15] A new study from the West Health-Gallup Center on Healthcare in America finds that 24% of employees, roughly 23 million adults, say they are in jobs they want to quit but remain because of fear of losing health insurance, up eight percentage points since 2021. [e001:f16] Job lock is most acute among workers with chronic health conditions and those highly stressed by health care costs, signaling rising benefits-driven risk aversion that can distort career decisions, delay entrepreneurship, and impede optimal workforce reallocation.

evidence.title: テスラ 「Cybercab」にStarlink統合｜ロボタクシーを止めない通信基盤へ
evidence.body: [e002:f01] CybercabへのStarlink統合から、ロボタクシーを支える通信設計の現在地を読み解きます。 [e002:f02] テスラの自動運転専用車Cybercabに、衛星通信サービスStarlinkが車載統合されることが、カリフォルニア州サンタナ・ロウの展示で明らかになった。 [e002:f03] From: Tesla Confirms Cybercab Will Be Its First Vehicle With Built-In Starlink 【編集部解説】 テスラがCybercabへのStarlink統合を明らかにしたことで、衛星通信が試験用の外付け機器ではなく、車両設計の一部として扱われることが確認されました。 [e002:f04] 公開された構成図にはStarlinkに加えて5G／LTEアンテナも記載されていますが、回線をどの条件で切り替えるのか、通信量をどう振り分けるのかといった具体的な仕様は公表されていません。 [e002:f05] テスラは自動運転ソフトウェアを車載ハードウェアと密接に統合する方針を示しており、周囲の認識や走行判断を外部通信へ常時依存させる構成とは区別して考える必要があります。 [e002:f06] Cybercabへの統合は、乗客向けインターネット接続だけでなく、無人車両をサービスとして維持するための通信手段という意味を持ちます。 [e002:f07] CybercabへのStarlink統合と技術的な方向は重なりますが、一般向けテスラ車への搭載計画を裏付けるものではなく、将来の車種展開については分けて考える必要があります。 [e002:f08] 日本ではテスラがCybercabやRobotaxiの構想を紹介しているものの、Cybercabの導入時期、Starlink統合車両の提供地域、利用料金、通信契約の扱いは示されていません。 [e002:f09] CybercabへのStarlink統合が示しているのは、自動運転車が単体で道路を走れるだけでは、ロボタクシー事業は成立しないということです。 [e002:f10] 【関連記事】 テスラ・ロボタクシー実証開始：Model Yで体験する新しい移動のカタチ テスラのロボタクシーがModel Yを使った限定運行から始まった経緯と、配車方法や監視体制を整理した記事。 [e002:f11] テスラ、6月末にオースティンでロボタクシー開始へ – 市当局は安全プロトコル情報を待つ中、10台のModel Yから始動 Robotaxiサービス開始前の運行計画、ジオフェンス、遠隔監視、市当局との情報共有を扱った記事。 [e002:f12] CybercabへのStarlink統合は、自動運転の華やかさより、運行を続けるための地道な設計を映しています。 [e002:f13] テスラの特許公開公報では、RF透過性を持つポリマー材料を車両ルーフに使用し、アンテナや電子部品を統合する構造が示されている。 [e002:f14] 【参考動画】 【参考記事】 CybercabのStarlink統合に関する投稿｜Tesla公式X （外部） Cybercabの車両構成とStarlink統合を示したテスラ公式の投稿。 [e002:f15] AI & Robotics｜Tesla （外部） 自動運転ソフトウェアと独自ハードウェアを密接に統合するテスラの開発方針を紹介する公式ページ。 [e002:f16] Vehicle roof assembly with integrated RF transparency for electronic module consolidation｜Google Patents （外部） RF透過性を持つポリマー製ルーフに、アンテナや衛星通信、LTEなどの電子部品を統合する車両構造を記載したテスラの米国特許公開公報。

previous_updates.title: SpaceX、上場後初の決算と9億株超のロックアップ解除へ
previous_updates.summary: SpaceXは8月4日に上場後初となる2026年第2四半期決算を発表する。 2営業日後の8月6日には最大9億1150万株のロックアップが解除され、7月22日終値ベースの時価は約1051億ドルに相当する。 株価は7月22日に6.7％下落して115.26ドルとなり、公募価格135ドルを14.6％下回った。 流通株の約32％に当たる約2億600万株が空売り用に借り入れられている。

evidence.title: SpaceX、上場後初の決算発表を8月4日に控え、9億株超のロックアップ解除が迫る
evidence.body: [e003:f01] SpaceXは8月4日、上場後初となる決算を発表する。 [e003:f02] 宇宙開発企業SpaceX（）は、上場以来最も重要な局面を迎えようとしている。 [e003:f03] 同社は8月4日に第2四半期決算を発表する予定で、これは6月に史上最大規模のIPOを完了して以来、初の決算発表となる。 [e003:f04] しかし、市場の関心はむしろ、決算発表の2日後となる8月6日に、最大9億1,150万株のインサイダー保有株のロックアップが解除される点に集中している。 [e003:f05] SpaceXの株価は22日（水）に6.7%の急落を演じ、終値は115.26ドル（約1万9,000円）となった。 [e003:f06] これは上場来安値を更新しただけでなく、135ドルの公募価格を約14.6%下回る「アンダーウォーター」状態に陥ったことを意味する。 [e003:f07] 上場後の6月16日に記録した日中高値225.64ドル（約3万7,000円）と比較すると、累計下落率は49%に迫っており、市場が高バリュエーション、初の決算内容、そしてロックアップ解除に伴う売り圧力といった複数の不確実性を織り込み始めていることを示している。 [e003:f08] 項目 内容 第1回ロックアップ解除日 2026年8月6日（初回決算発表後の2営業日目） 第1回解除規模 最大9億1,150万株（制限付き保有株の20%） 対応する時価総額 約1,051億ドル（約17.2兆円） 条件付き追加解除 決算前10営業日中に5日間、終値が175.50ドルに達した場合、最大4億5,580万株を追加解除 現在の流通株式数 約6億3,900万株 年末までの流通株式数 約53億3,000万株に増加見込み マスクCEO保有株 約78億株（総株式数の約60%）、ロックアップ期間は上場後1年以上に延長 注：対応する時価総額は7月22日終値115.26ドルに基づく試算。 [e003:f09] 条件付き追加解除のトリガー価格である175.50ドル（約2万9,000円）は、IPO公募価格135ドルに30%上乗せした水準。 [e003:f10] 金融分析機関S3パートナーズの推計によると、現在約2億600万株のSpaceX株が空売りのために借り入れられており、これは公開市場で取引可能な流通株の約32%に相当する。 [e003:f11] この数字は先週の1億8,500万株（29%）からさらに増加しており、約1カ月前の4,000万株（約5～7%）と比較すると、その急増ぶりが際立つ。 [e003:f12] S3のリサーチ責任者マシュー・ウンターマン氏は、初の決算発表とロックアップ解除という重要なカタリスト（株価変動要因）を前に、空売り勢がリスクエクスポージャーを積極的に積み増していると指摘する。 [e003:f13] 同機関の推計では、空売り勢の現在の帳簿上の利益は約70億ドル（約1.1兆円）に達している。 [e003:f14] ファクトセットのデータによると、アナリストによるSpaceXの平均目標株価は約241ドル（約3万9,000円）であり、いずれも現在の株価を大きく上回る。 [e003:f15] これはSpaceXがスターリンク衛星ネットワークを拡大する上で鍵となるだけでなく、米国航空宇宙局（NASA）の「アルテミス」計画における契約履行の中核を担うものだ。 [e003:f16] 今後2週間、SpaceXは試験飛行の結果、初の決算発表、そして初回のロックアップ解除という3つの関門に連続して直面する。

previous_updates.title: SpaceXの軌道データセンター構想、1GWで1700億ドル試算
previous_updates.summary: SpaceXがIPO投資家へ示した軌道データセンター構想について、地政学アナリストのPeter Zeihanは、1GW施設の組み立てにStarship約500回の打ち上げが必要と試算した。 宇宙では放射線遮蔽とGPUの排熱が課題となり、Wood Mackenzieは1GW施設の総費用を約1700億ドル、地上設備の約3倍と見積もった。 予測市場では1MWの軌道データセンターが2029年1月までに稼働する確率を14％と評価する。 SpaceXは地上側ではAnthropicと月額12億5000万ドルの計算能力契約を結んでいる。

evidence.title: SpaceX successfully launched Starship and for the first time put 20 latest Starlink satellites into orbit
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The ship successfully splashed down in the Indian Ocean, while the booster fell into the Gulf of Mexico. [e004:f02] SpaceX conducted the 13th test flight of the Starship rocket, during which it launched 20 new-generation Starlink satellites into orbit for the first time. [e004:f03] This was reported by the Associated Press, writes UNN . [e004:f04] Details The launch took place from the company's spaceport in southern Texas. [e004:f05] The flight lasted about an hour and ended with the spacecraft splashing down in the Indian Ocean, where it remained afloat for some time. [e004:f06] According to AP, before the launch, SpaceX replaced six of the 33 first-stage engines after a previous attempt had to be canceled due to a technical malfunction. [e004:f07] During the new flight, all engines started successfully, but the booster failed to perform a controlled return and fell into the Gulf of Mexico. [e004:f08] Musk plans to launch his own Starlink mobile service in the US – FT 28.06.26, 17:14 • 4381 view At the same time, the spacecraft itself continued its flight and sequentially deployed 20 Starlink satellites into orbit at an altitude of about 200 km, after which it entered the atmosphere and made a soft splashdown in the Indian Ocean. [e004:f09] NASA monitored the test As AP notes, the launch was an important milestone for NASA's Artemis program, as the agency plans to use Starship as a lunar landing module for future missions to the Moon. [e004:f10] I look forward to what we will learn from this mission During the mission, the new Starlink satellites successfully established laser communication with already operational spacecraft in orbit. [e004:f11] In addition, SpaceX tested an improved Starship heat shield equipped with sensors to collect data during atmospheric entry. [e004:f12] SpaceX is laying the Starpipe gas pipeline to accelerate Starship rocket launches 26.06.26, 06:16 • 4336 views Stepan Haftko News of the World Technologies SpaceX Starship Starlink Associated Press SpaceX NASA Texas Indian Ocean。

evidence.title: SpaceXは、Starlink Miniキットの価格を192ドルに値下げし、月額16ドルの分割払いプランも提供開始した。

evidence.title: State of Louisiana signs grant agreement with Starlink to provide internet access to rural parishes
evidence.body: [e001:f01] ConnectLA Executive Director Veneeth Iyengar says Starlink will deliver high-speed internet access to more than 10,000 rural locations in more than 50 parishes by the end of the summer. [e001:f02] “The cost of providing fiber connectivity for some of these locations was going to be so expensive that likely it would have made better sense, and it would have been quicker, to connect these folks with Starlink,” Iyengar explained. [e001:f03] Iyengar says under the partnership with the state, the customers will get the equipment for free, and the service will be about $55 a month for good, reliable high-speed internet. [e001:f04] “The state law states high-speed internet as 100 megabits download and 20 megabits upload. [e001:f05] Starlink has consistently shown that they provide in excess of those speeds,” Iyengar noted. [e001:f06] Iyengar reiterates that Starlink is only intended for locations which are so rural that it’s impossible to install fiber internet in a cost-effective way. [e001:f07] “I would say 98%-99% of the state’s going to be covered with fiber. [e001:f08] And then those areas where there is no fiber will be serviced by either Starlink or another solution; in this case, fixed wireless,” Iyengar said. evidence.title: Starlink Signs Louisiana BEAD Deal to Connect 10,600 Rural Homes
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The deal highlights a growing role for satellite broadband in closing connectivity gaps that fiber infrastructure simply cannot close economically. [e003:f02] Source: @SawyerMerritt — July 24, 2026 Why Fiber Wasn't the Answer Here Louisiana's broader broadband strategy calls for fiber to reach 98–99% of the state — but that last 1–2% represents tens of thousands of locations where trenching fiber is either technically impractical or financially ruinous. [e003:f03] According to ConnectLA Executive Director Veneeth Iyengar, Starlink emerged as the cost-effective solution for exactly these edge cases. [e003:f04] Governor Jeff Landry framed the partnership in practical terms, noting that Starlink has already demonstrated its value to Louisiana during disaster relief operations — a track record that gave state officials confidence in the technology's reliability when it matters most. [e003:f05] Lauren Dreyer, Vice President of Starlink Business Operations at SpaceX, confirmed the service will deliver reliable, high-speed, low-latency broadband — and that it will exceed Louisiana's statutory definition of high-speed internet: 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload. [e003:f06] The Numbers Behind the Agreement Detail Value Target locations 10,635 rural addresses Geographic reach 50+ parishes statewide Completion target End of summer 2026 Equipment cost to customer $0 (provided at no charge) Monthly service cost ~$55/month Speed standard Exceeds 100 Mbps down / 20 Mbps up (LA state threshold) The Bigger Picture for Starlink Louisiana is one piece of a much larger federal broadband push. [e003:f07] The BEAD program — administered through the National Telecommunications and Information Administration — allocated $42.5 billion nationally to expand broadband access, and states are now moving through the contracting phase. [e003:f08] Starlink's ability to deploy quickly without ground infrastructure gives it a structural advantage in winning the rural portions of these contracts, where traditional ISPs often decline to bid at all. [e003:f09] For SpaceX, government BEAD agreements represent a meaningful and recurring revenue stream that complements Starlink's direct-to-consumer and enterprise businesses. [e003:f10] Winning contracts across multiple states also strengthens the case for continued satellite constellation expansion — each new agreement effectively pre-sells capacity that justifies future Starship-launched batches of next-generation Starlink satellites. [e003:f11] The Louisiana deal is a concrete example of how Starlink is evolving from a consumer novelty into critical public infrastructure. [e003:f12] With equipment costs absorbed by the program and monthly pricing set at $55, the barrier to adoption for rural households is lower than it has ever been — and the end-of-summer deadline means this isn't a distant promise. [e003:f13] For our full SpaceX coverage , including Starlink's broader expansion efforts, follow along as more state-level agreements are expected to be announced in the months ahead. evidence.title: Bloomberg: SpaceX No Longer Booking Falcon Launches Past 2028
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Photo: Falcon 9 lifting of from Cape Canaveral's SLC-40 in July, 2026. [e002:f02] Photo: Charles Boyer Bloomberg reported Thursday that SpaceX has begun turning away satellite operators seeking dedicated Falcon 9 launches beyond 2028, citing "people familiar with the matter." The company has also stopped accepting new reservations for its Falcon 9 rideshare program, the missions that pack dozens of smallsats onto a single booster. [e002:f03] Those pads have driven the launch cadence that reshaped Brevard County over the past decade. [e002:f04] The area has been spoiled for the past few years with a Falcon 9 launching every few days, but those launches are set to be replaced by the thundering Starship in the next few years. [e002:f05] Starship Set To Replace Falcon 9 Starship Heavy on the launch pad at SpaceX's Boca Chica Texas launch facility. [e002:f06] Once past the exhuberance of the SPCX has traded below its initial $135 price, and HSBC opened coverage this week with a hold rating and a $115 target. [e002:f07] That first orbital flight will probably come this year, and SpaceX is working day and night to construct two Starship launch facilities at the Cape. [e002:f08] The company says it plans to launch Starship from here in Florida late this year, and at this point, in mid-summer, it looks entirely possible; if not by the end of the year, then very early in 2027. [e002:f09] The original target was mid-2025 for the first Antares 330 flight from Wallops LP-0A, but as of now the vehicle has yet to launch. [e002:f10] The current placeholder for the debut of Antares 330 is Cygnus NG-24, listed around late December 2026 on the launch trackers. [e002:f11] United Launch Alliance's Vulcan CERT-1 lifting off on January 8, : Charles Boyer / Talk of Titusville Rocket Lab is positioned as an obvious beneficiary if Falcon availability tightens before Neutron matures. [e002:f12] Neutron, like most new rocket projects, is late, and it may be 2027 before it makes its debut, but the company is showing palpable signs of progress: Neutron's Archimedes engine testing has hit milestones recently, and the commercial side for Neutron is strong. [e002:f13] Rocket Lab sold a block of five Neutron flights plus three Electron flights to an undisclosed customer in May, a contract that beat their previous $190M record. [e002:f14] There are also new entrants to the medium-launch market: Relativity Space and Stoke Space plan to fly their new rockets sometime next year, and over time, they could help fill the gap left by Falcon 9. [e002:f15] Both companies plan to launch from Cape Canaveral and are building launch facilities there. [e002:f16] Falcon 9 won't go away entirely, not for a long time, but it currently looks like there will be a plethora of launch vehicles flying from Florida in just a year or two, and also that there will be far fewer Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy rockets in the mix.
